title: InvoiceExtraction
description: Evidence Agent output for one invoice document (PDF or image), 'extraction' route. Unknown values use the literal 'UNKNOWN'. Deterministic cross-checks against the claim form are done by the invoice_validation tool, not by the model.

evidenceRef.description: Harness-issued reference of the invoice, e.g. 'EV-1'. Must match an issued reference (validated).

totalAmount.description: Line amount for the claimed product; 0 when unknown.

anomalies.description: Visible irregularities, e.g. altered dates, inconsistent fonts, missing seller details.
